item.title: Ni‐Regulated Partial Reconstruction of Hydrated Vanadium Oxide for Fast and Durable Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a one-step hydrothermal route coupling glucose-induced reductive reconstruction with Ni²⁺ incorporation, creating Ni-regulated hydrated vanadium oxide with coexisting H₂V₃O₈ and Ni-containing domains. DFT screening identifies Ni²⁺ for lowest Zn²⁺ migration barriers. The domain-balanced architecture enables 433.4 mAh g⁻¹ at 0.1 A g⁻¹ and 282.6 mAh g⁻¹ after 6000 cycles, establishing coupled reconstruction and guest-ion regulation for durable aqueous zinc-ion cathodes.
🏷 aqueous zinc-ion battery · vanadium oxide cathode · Ni regulation · structural reconstruction · cycling stability

item.title: Ultrahigh discharge voltage plateau of 3.2 V achieved in Li-CO 2 batteries using iron polyphthalocyanine
item.description:

Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Iron polyphthalocyanine as a solid-state redox mediator redirects Li-CO₂ battery chemistry to form Li₂C₂O₄ instead of Li₂CO₃, enabling a 3.2 V discharge plateau beyond the theoretical limit, 28,790 mAh/g capacity, 1400-hour cycling, and −40 to 80°C adaptability. Pouch cells reach 678 Wh/kg, advancing practical high-efficiency Li-CO₂ batteries.

item.title: Harnessing interfacial kosmotropic effect for reversible quasi-solid-state zinc-iodine batteries
item.description:
اثر kosmotropic بین‌سطحی با CaSO4·2H2O برای باتری‌های zinc-iodine نیمه‌جامد، منجر به واکنش تک‌مرحله‌ای I−/I2 و پایداری بالا می‌شود.
Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces an interfacial kosmotropic effect using low-cost CaSO₄·2H₂O to reconstruct electric double-layer chemistry in quasi-solid-state Zn-I₂ batteries. It enables single-step I⁻/I₂ redox, suppresses polyiodides, and stabilizes Zn anodes over 1000 h. The strategy supports iodine-free cathodes and pouch-cell scaling, offering a paradigm shift toward safe, high-rate, durable batteries.
